no-restricted-globals.name: Date
no-restricted-globals.message: Ambient clock read. Use `yield* DateTime.now` (effect/DateTime) inside an Effect, not `new Date()`/`Date.now()` — see apps/worker/src/corpus/observe.ts.

no-restricted-globals.name: crypto
no-restricted-globals.message: Ambient id/random read. Use the `Ids` service (apps/worker/src/services/Ids.ts), not `crypto.randomUUID()` directly.

no-restricted-globals.name: fetch
no-restricted-globals.message: Ambient network call. Take `HttpClient` (effect/unstable/http/HttpClient) as a constructor argument, not the global `fetch` — see packages/adapters/nav/src/index.ts.
